The Strategy and Future Department is seeking an AI Adoption Programme Manager who will be responsible for leading the day-to-day implementation of Zayed University's Agentic AI Framework, acting as the formal liaison with the UAE Government's Agentic AI Project national PMO, and coordinating AI Workstream Coordinators, AI Domain Leads and the AI Implementation Partner/Vendor across all phases of delivery, to ensure the University meets its national AI transformation targets, scales AI adoption responsibly across academic and operational functions, and delivers measurable institutional value in line with ZU's strategic objectives and the UAE AI Strategy 2031.

The Responsibilities

Strategic & Programme Governance

Translate the approved AI Framework into a detailed, sequenced delivery plan and governance action plan, aligned to the timeline and reporting requirements of the UAE Government's Agentic AI Project.
Act as ZU's dedicated point of contact and formal liaison with the National PMO, ensuring timely submission of action plans, wave reports and performance data.
Report progress, risks and resourcing needs to the AI Strategic Committee and the Zayed University Agentic AI Taskforce, escalating matters of institutional significance.
Consolidate budget and resourcing requirements for the AI programme, including vendor/implementation partner costs, and submit for review and approval.
Identify risks, dependencies and operational roadblocks across the AI programme and recommend mitigation strategies to protect delivery timelines.

Coordinate with the AI and Data Technologies Workstream and IT/Digital Transformation on technology sourcing, integration architecture, data readiness and security requirements.
Support the formalisation of AI governance: Committee Terms of Reference, decision rights, acceptable-use policy, assessment policy and risk-review/escalation processes.
Coordinate the design and rollout of role-based AI literacy and capability-building programmes for faculty, staff and students, incorporating FAHR training requirements.
Establish and support the AI Champions Network to cascade knowledge and sustain adoption across colleges and business units.
Track and report programme KPIs, adoption metrics, training completion rates and use-case outcomes, feeding lessons learned into successive waves.
Manage incident reporting and escalation for live AI use cases in line with approved national procedures.
Prepare briefing materials, decision papers and progress reports for university leadership, the Board of Trustees and national stakeholders.

Identify capability and resourcing gaps within the AI programme team and liaise with HR/Strategy & Future leadership to address them.

Master's degree with a minimum of 10 years of experience and at least 6 years in a managerial position.

Certification in Programme/Project Management (e.g. PMP, MSP, PRINCE2) and/or AI-related certification is preferred.
Written and spoken English and Arabic language is a must.

We're about the people, experiences, and longevity of a building. We love the process of bringing buildings to life – and keeping them in shape long after the doors open.

As an ESOP, each of our employee-owners are an essential part of our mission to lead the industry in innovation, sustainability, and client experience. With a vision to build a better world, Team Henderson has a people-first culture and diverse portfolio of world-class facilities.

It's What We Do

We provide total building system design and construction services across multiple high-growth markets throughout the country for industry leaders. You'll get to use your talent to work on projects for some of the biggest names in mission-critical, higher education, sports, healthcare, grocery, restaurant, and retail within the sectors we serve in business, community, grocery, health, retail, and venue.

It's How We're Different

We're about more than just buildings. We're about you. You, and the hundreds of passionate employee-owners who make us who we are. We’ve always been committed to providing an inclusive workplace where people can bring their full self to work and helps people reach their full potential – both as professionals and individuals. Together, we provide dream-up innovative solutions for our clients industry-wide problems, design and construct spaces that become landmarks, and toast the good life at our happy hours. Take a peek into what makes us different here: https://youtu.be/AIt17t_uJ-A?si=oSMy5zQeUcb_faE3

Position Summary

The Practice Manager drives growth by cultivating strong client relationships, expanding account opportunities, and maintaining a robust sales pipeline. This role leads client engagement, identifies new business prospects, and ensures successful solution delivery that supports long‑term partnerships. Serving as the primary client contact, the Practice Manager proactively manages expectations, uncovers emerging needs, and collaborates with sector leadership to position the practice for sustained expansion. They help qualify leads, shape proposals, and support pursuit strategies aligned with sector priorities, with responsibilities potentially focused on a specific geography or market segment.

Beyond client engagement, the Practice Manager is the escalation point for the project managers and or clients to ensure work is delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with client objectives. They oversee planning, monitor progress, manage risks, and coordinate resources to maintain high‑quality outcomes that encourage repeat business. While they may guide production staff as needed, the role centers on relationship management, opportunity development, and strengthening the practice’s market presence. This role is highly matrixed and may include accountabilities to all members of the Sector Leadership team for their sector.

This position can be remote, however, if you are located near a current Henderson Engineers office, the work schedule will be hybrid..

Essential Job Functions & Accountabilities

Operations

Maintains efficient practice operations that support strong client delivery and revenue growth
Monitors workload, resource allocation, and project timelines to ensure commitments are met.
Partners with Practice Director for the development and oversight of the practice level budget.
Actively participates in industry-specific committees, task forces, and other thought leadership opportunities at a local or regional level.
Implements and refines processes that improve consistency, quality, and responsiveness across engagements.
Partners with sector leadership to align operational priorities with business development goals.
Tracks key performance indicators (KPIs) related to pipeline health, client activity, and project execution.

Employee Engagement & Teamwork

Practices effective employee relations and personnel management within the practice.
Teams with engineering managers to align appropriate training, development, and mentorship of talent.
Supports leaders in the sector to ensure proper staffing and execution of projects.
Communicates opportunities and gaps in employee development to practice and sector leadership.
Collaborates with organizational, sector, practice, and/or office leadership to foster an engaged, dynamic employee culture and lead company-wide events and initiatives.

Client Experience

Manages existing client relationships, and supports new client and market development, especially within their geographical region or market segment, as requested by Practice Director.
Maintains knowledge and presence within the industry to contribute to project pursuits.
Assists Practice Director and marketing staff to generate proposals and determine a profitable fee structure that aligns with the practice strategy.
Ensures delivery teams understand client objectives and consistently meet or exceed expectations.
Lead client communications, expectation setting, and issue resolution throughout the engagement lifecycle

Project Management

Oversees project planning, scope definition, timelines, and resource coordination to ensure successful delivery.
Monitors project progress, risks, and dependencies, escalating issues when needed to maintain client satisfaction.
Works with project managers to ensure projects are delivered on time, within scope, and aligned with client goals and quality standards.

Core Competencies

Communication

Keeps others well informed and prioritizes audiences, accuracy, and timeliness.
Facilitates an efficient, consistent workflow and exchange of information.
Adjusts communication based on needs and make-up of audience.

Integrity

Leads by example, challenges assumptions, and creates candid feedback loops.
Aligns personal actions and words, extends and receives trust, and upholds commitments.
Maintains the confidence of clients and colleagues, especially when handling sensitive information.

Quality Orientation

Creates a sense of urgency to tackle problems and rewards responsiveness.
Recognizes opportunity for improvement, creating and supporting processes and feedback to improve results.
Holds others accountable for doing their best work.

Teamwork/Inclusion

Promotes a culture of collaboration across roles and teams.
Navigates difficult conversations with diplomacy and leverages cooperative efforts to resolve conflict.
Confronts exclusionary behavior and participates productively in discussions of diverse, sensitive societal topics.

Continuous Learning

Pursues challenging assignments and new knowledge.
Encourages experimentation when faced with new challenges.
Examines mistakes, clarifies lessons learned, and applies to future work.

Functional/Technical Expertise

Leverages area of expertise to contribute to team and company goals.
Promotes an environment where people openly share their expertise, experiences, opinions, ideas, and perspectives.
Maintains knowledge, skills, and abilities relevant to success throughout job functions.

Leadership

INSPIRES THE ORGANIZATION

Personifies the values of the organization and champions organizational culture and vision, earnestly supporting and mobilizing decisions made by organizational leadership.
Navigates ambiguity and change in a positive way, proactively seeking support from leadership when needed.

Focuses On Client Experience

Fosters positive client relationships and coaches others to do the same, striving for best-in-class service and internal and external client satisfaction.
Anticipates and responds proactively to changes in client needs, priorities, and/or expectations, ensuring quality results.

Develops The Strengths Of Others

Demonstrates empathy and builds strong relationships with colleagues.
Seeks and shares productive feedback with candor to help others grow, celebrating the effort, progress, and everyday wins of colleagues.

DRIVES ACCOUNTABILITY, QUALITY, AND INNOVATION

Expects and drives high-quality results and welcomes innovative strategies, especially in times of change.
Models financially responsible behaviors and coaches others to be fiscally mindful as employee-owners.

Required Education, Experience, Licenses & Technical Competencies

Bachelor’s degree in any engineering field, construction management, science, technology, marketing, or business preferred. Years of relevant experience in leadership/management position will be considered in lieu of requisite education.
Eight (8) or greater years of relevant experience, with a minimum of two (2) years personnel or project management experience.
Demonstrated success building and managing a sales pipeline, qualifying leads, and supporting pursuit strategies.
Experience managing client engagements or projects from initiation through delivery.
Background working in a consulting, professional services, or matrixed environment strongly preferred.
Experience collaborating with cross‑functional teams to deliver client solutions and drive revenue growth.
Demonstrates excellent motivation, team leading, and the ability to achieve goals and objectives.
Broad proficiency of engineering design fundamentals and advanced knowledge of the A&E industry, codes, design guides, and standards. Knowledge may apply to a broad range of practice, project, or program types.
Must demonstrate proficiency in all core competencies as described and characterized in this job description.
Other duties as assigned.

Physical & Other Requirements

Prolonged periods of sitting or standing at a desk and working on a computer.
Ability to read, write and communicate in English.

We take care of our people. As a Henderson employee, you'll enjoy some pretty awesome perks. Trust us, your friends will all have work envy.

Flexible Work Hours (Because we all need to balance work and life.)
Casual Dress Code (Be yourself, please.)

jobs.title: Business Operations Manager
jobs.description:
Job Description

The Business Operations Manager
is a hands-on business partner who helps delivery leaders manage the operational health of government and commercial services programs. The role connects program data to business decisions by monitoring revenue, margin, forecasts, delivery milestones, and risk. This position works closely with delivery, sales, finance, accounting, contracts, HR, procurement, and operations teams and supports executive and delivery leaders across national security, federal, and commercial portfolios.

Key Responsibilities

Own project controls oversight, to include recurring analysis and reporting for program and portfolio performance, including revenue, cost, margin, backlog, forecasts, staffing, utilization, and other key performance indicators.
Monitor project execution against financial plans, delivery schedules, customer commitments, contractual requirements, and internal targets to help ensure programs remain on time, on margin, and positioned to achieve revenue objectives.
Identify performance variances, emerging risks, and unfavorable trends by determining business drivers behind the numbers, assessing potential impact, and recommending corrective actions or escalation paths.
Partner directly with the Chief Delivery Officer and Managing Directors supporting national security, federal, and commercial delivery portfolios.
Challenge assumptions and communicate directly with delivery and business leaders when results and execution plans are off track by presenting an assessment, standing behind the analysis, and helping leaders translate recommendations into action.
Serve as the bridge between financial data and operational execution by converting complex program metrics into clear business implications for leaders.
Prepare and maintain executive-ready dashboards, reports, scorecards, and presentation materials for quarterly business reviews, operational reviews, customer discussions, and larger organizational meetings.
Brief leaders and broader audiences on performance metrics, risks, trends, and recommendations. Respond confidently to questions and explain or defend the underlying conclusions.
Coordinate with Finance and Accounting on project financials, forecasting, budget performance, margin analysis, and data integrity; reconcile discrepancies and ensure reporting is timely and accurate.
Partner with Program Managers, Delivery Managers, Sales, Contracts, HR, and Procurement to support operational planning, resource needs, staffing changes, onboarding, timekeeping compliance, purchasing activities, and other program requirements.
Support contract and program governance by tracking deliverables, reporting deadlines, compliance requirements, action items, and required documentation across government and commercial engagements.
Build and improve repeatable operating processes, reporting tools, templates, and controls that increase visibility, consistency, and accountability across the delivery organization.
Manage multiple priorities and deadlines in a fast-paced environment while maintaining a high level of accuracy, organization, follow-through, and attention to detail.

Required Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Business, Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business Analytics, or related fields.
Eight to 10 years of experience in business operations, delivery operations, program or project management, sales, or finance within a government contracting environment in support of mid-large sized government contractors or complexed, matrixed federal services organizations.
Strong understanding of project and program financials, including revenue, cost, margin, forecasting, and budget performance.
Demonstrated ability to analyze data, identify risks, assess business impact, and develop well-supported recommendations.
Advanced proficiency with Microsoft OS and experience preparing accurate financial or operational reports, dashboards, and executive-level presentation materials.
Strong written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to explain numbers in clear business terms and tailor communication for delivery leaders, executives, and cross-functional partners.
Confidence and professional judgment to raise concerns, navigate difficult conversations, respectfully challenge leaders, and maintain an objective point of view when recommendations are questioned.
Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage competing priorities, meet recurring reporting deadlines, and maintain accuracy in a fast-paced environment.
Ability to work independently in an individual contributor role while building productive relationships across Finance, Accounting, Sales, Delivery, Contracts, HR, Procurement, and Operations.

Preferred Qualifications

Working knowledge of FAR/DFARS requirements and common government contracting program controls or financial processes.
Experience with enterprise financial systems, project accounting tools, data visualization platforms, project management tools, and/or business intelligence reporting.
Experience supporting quarterly business reviews, operating reviews, portfolio reviews, or similar executive performance discussions.

What’s in it For You?

Hybrid Work Model: We’ve adopted a flexible hybrid working environment for our office-based roles while delivering a seamless experience that is digitally and physically connected.
Flexibility & Work-Life Balance: Flex My Way is a set of supportive workplace policies designed to help manage personal and professional responsibilities, whether caring for family, giving back to the community, or finding time to refresh and reset. This builds upon our flexible work arrangements, including work from anywhere for up to 8 weeks per year, empowering employees to achieve a better work-life balance.
Career Development and Growth: By fostering a culture of continuous learning and skill development, we prepare our talent to tackle tomorrow’s challenges and deliver real-world solutions. Our Grow My Way programming and skills-first approach ensures you have the tools and knowledge to grow, lead, and thrive in an AI-enabled future.
Industry Competitive Benefits: We offer comprehensive benefit plans to include flexible vacation, two company-wide Mental Health Days off, access to the Headspace app, retirement savings, tuition reimbursement, employee incentive programs, and resources for mental, physical, and financial wellbeing.
Culture: Globally recognized, award-winning reputation for inclusion and belonging, flexibility, work-life balance, and more. We live by our values: Obsess over our Customers, Compete to Win, Challenge (Y)our Thinking, Act Fast / Learn Fast, and Stronger Together.
Social Impact: Make an impact in your community with our Social Impact Institute. We offer employees two paid volunteer days off annually and opportunities to get involved with pro-bono consulting projects and Environmental, Social, and Governance (ESG) initiatives.
Making a Real-World Impact: We are one of the few companies globally that helps its customers pursue justice, truth, and transparency. Together, with the professionals and institutions we serve, we help uphold the rule of law, turn the wheels of commerce, catch bad actors, report the facts, and provide trusted, unbiased information to people all over the world.

In the United States, Thomson Reuters offers a comprehensive benefits package to our employees. Our benefit package includes market competitive health, dental, vision, disability, and life insurance programs, as well as a competitive 401k plan with company match. In addition, Thomson Reuters offers market leading work life benefits with competitive vacation, sick and safe paid time off, paid holidays (including two company mental health days off), parental leave, sabbatical leave. These benefits meet or exceeds the requirements of paid time off in accordance with any applicable state or municipal laws. Finally, Thomson Reuters offers the following additional benefits: optional hospital, accident and sickness insurance paid 100% by the employee; optional life and AD&D insurance paid 100% by the employee; Flexible Spending and Health Savings Accounts; fitness reimbursement; access to Employee Assistance Program; Group Legal Identity Theft Protection benefit paid 100% by employee; access to 529 Plan; commuter benefits; Adoption & Surrogacy Assistance; Tuition Reimbursement; and access to Employee Stock Purchase Plan.

Thomson Reuters complies with local laws that require upfront disclosure of the expected pay range for a position. The base compensation range varies across locations. Eligible office location(s) for this role include one or more of the following: New York City, San Francisco, Los Angeles, and/or Irvine, CA; McLean, VA; Washington, DC. The base compensation range for the role in any of those locations is $115,300 USD - $214,100 USD. Base pay is positioned within the range based on several factors including an individual’s knowledge, skills and experience with consideration given to internal equity. Base pay is one part of a comprehensive Total Reward program which also includes flexible and supportive benefits and other wellbeing programs. This role may also be eligible for an Annual Bonus based on a combination of enterprise and individual performance.

jobs.title: Implementation Manager
jobs.description:
Profound is the fastest-growing AI marketing platform, used by 15% of the Fortune 500 including Comcast, Estée Lauder, and Walmart, and innovators like Ramp, MongoDB, and Figma. It is where marketing teams do the work: research, briefs, content, campaigns, reporting, all in one place, alongside agents that carry the load with them.

Built on 2B+ real user prompts and growing, Profound’s data shows you what people ask AI and what the models say back. Profound's AI Marketer joins that data with deep context about our customers to find the opportunities worth acting on, and then puts agents to work: automating reporting, drafting content, auditing pages for readability, running competitive research. It measures what works and gets better every day.

As an Implementation Manager, you'll own onboarding and enablement execution for our Scaled and Mid-Market customers, ensuring stakeholders are set up for success from day one. You'll run onboarding at scale through recurring sessions, strengthen the systems and curriculum that make the motion repeatable, and ensure customers realize value quickly — independently managing a high volume of implementations and adapting the playbook when customer circumstances require a different approach.

Partnering closely with Customer Success, Sales, Product, Engineering, and Data, you'll create a best-in-class onboarding experience. This is a build role. You are not stepping into a finished system — you are helping define how onboarding works at scale.

What you’ll do

Own the implementation journey for a high-volume portfolio of Scaled and Mid-Market customers, from platform configuration and setup through early value realization
Run weekly onboarding sessions covering platform setup, prompt creation, report interpretation, and Q&A
Design and continuously improve the scaled onboarding curriculum that serves as the primary implementation motion for Scaled and Mid-Market customers
Build the enablement infrastructure including session templates, help content, and follow-up sequences to make onboarding scalable without sacrificing quality
Independently handle escalations and implementation blockers, adapting established playbooks when customer circumstances require a different approach
Define and track implementation performance metrics, like time to value, configuration completion rate, and operational efficiency, recognizing patterns to continuously improve the quality and efficiency of the implementation motion
Evolve the implementation motion as our customer base grows, building a process that scales without proportional headcount
Surface product gaps, onboarding friction, and recurring issues to Customer Success and Product teams, and create or improve playbooks based on repeated experience
Serve as the internal expert on how customers actually use Profound — a dependable subject-matter resource for teammates — and translate that insight into stronger programs, content, and strategy

Who you are

4-6 years of experience in customer success, onboarding, implementation, or customer education
You understand the gap between “sold” and “successful,” and have owned the motion that closes it — consistently producing strong outcomes across demanding, high-volume engagements
You know how to tie implementation to the product value and communicate that to keep customers motivated through the process
Strong facilitator, comfortable leading group sessions, webinars, and office hours with stakeholders at varying levels of sophistication
Organized program owner who can build a repeatable system from scratch, keep it running, and demonstrate reliable performance across a broad portfolio
Skilled at handling difficult conversations, balancing short-term customer needs against longer-term program objectives, and maintaining customer trust in moments of ambiguity or change
Process-oriented and data-aware, tracking what works and improving what does not
Comfortable operating independently in ambiguity and building systems rather than inheriting them
Power user of AI tools who uses them to transform workflows, increase leverage, and drive meaningful efficiency gains
AI search experience is a plus

Location

This is an on-site role based in our NYC, San Francisco, or London designed for builders who thrive on speed, iteration, and meaningful impact.

For this role, the expected base is $129,600 to $138,000 before variable compensation (NYC and SF) and £81,600 to £87,200 before variable compensation (London). Profound’s total compensation package is designed to be competitive and includes base salary, variable compensation, equity, and a full range of benefits and perks. Final compensation will depend on factors such as your skills, experience, qualifications, and location, and will be determined during the interview process. Our recruiting team will share more details about the full compensation package and benefits as you move through hiring.

About The Business

Year after year, the most influential market analysts endorsed Deloitte Consulting as owning the intersection of business and technology.

Deloitte Consulting is the world's largest management consulting practice and one of the top consulting firms in China.
In global, we have over 101,000 professionals spreading in over 100 countries/locations.
China Consulting has over 3,400 professional experts and consultants with bilingual service capabilities. Our talents are located in 16 cities in Great China including Beijing, Chengdu, Chongqing, Dalian, Hangzhou, Harbin, Hong Kong, Jinan, Macau, Nanjing, Shanghai, Shenzhen, Shenyang, Tianjin, Taipei, Zhengzhou.

Work you'll do

Role Summary

Analyst / Consultant with computer science or information management background, responsible for end‑to‑end implementation of core banking services (Deposits, CIF, Loans, General Ledger), including business requirement gathering, data migration and testing.

Key Responsibilities

Partner with business stakeholders (retail, operations, finance, risk) to elicit, analyze and document business and system requirements for core banking modules (Deposits, CIF, Loans, GL).
Translate business requirements into functional and technical specifications, user stories and process flows for development and vendor teams.
Analyse current-state legacy systems and data structures, perform gap analysis versus target core banking platform capabilities.
Define data migration scope and strategy, including data mapping from legacy Deposit/CIF/Loan/GL systems to target schemas, data cleansing rules and transformation logic
Work with data and technical teams to design and validate ETL jobs, migration tools and staging processes, ensuring data accuracy, completeness and reconciliation.
Develop test strategies, test cases and test data for functional, integration, migration and user acceptance testing across core banking modules
Execute and coordinate testing, log and track defects, support root cause analysis and verify fixes in collaboration with vendors and internal IT
Support configuration and parameterization of core banking products (account types, interest schemes, fee rules, GL mappings) in line with business requirements and control standards
Prepare user manuals and training materials, deliver training and go‑live support to business and operations users.
Monitor post‑implementation performance, support issue triage and stabilization, and identify opportunities for process and system enhancements.

During your tenure with us, you will demonstrate and develop your leadership and professional capabilities in the following areas: Inspiring, Creating purpose, Driving agility, Building diverse capability, Influencing, Collaborating, Delivering value, Building the business, Analytical acumen, Effective communication, Engagement management/delivery excellence, Managing change, Managing quality & risk, Sales excellence, Strategic thinking and problem solving, and Tech savviness.

We are looking for someone with

Degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Information Management, or related discipline.
1–3 years’ experience as Business Analyst, Systems Analyst or Consultant in banking or financial services, with hands‑on involvement in core banking implementation or upgrade projects.
Strong understanding of core banking processes for Deposits, CIF, Loans or General Ledger, including end‑to‑end customer and account lifecycle, product setup and accounting flows.
Demonstrated experience in business requirement gathering, process mapping and documentation using standard templates and tools.
Practical experience in data migration projects (scoping, mapping, cleansing, reconciliation, migration testing).
Solid knowledge of software testing life cycle, test planning and execution (SIT, UAT, regression, migration verification).
Ability to liaise between business users, technical teams and vendors, with strong communication and stakeholder management skills.
Familiarity with SQL and database concepts, and comfort working with large datasets for analysis, profiling and reconciliation is an advantage

Shape your future through impact that matters

For more than 100 years of history, Deloitte witnessed also had the honor to be part of the economic boom in China by providing industry-leading audit & assurance, consulting, risk advisory, financial advisory, tax & business advisory services to nearly 90% of the Fortune Global 500 Chinese companies and thousands of private companies. Deloitte China today carries on our centenary professionalism and strives to become the undisputed leader in professional services in China with strong responsibility and capabilities in digitalization and multidisciplinary services.

Deloitte has been named China's Top Employer since 2006, Universum's Most Attractive Employer in China since 2008, and the Best Workplaces in Greater China since 2019.

jobs.title: Product Strategy Analyst (Planning)
jobs.description:
Bij Protime
helpen we organisaties in heel Europa
om tijd slimmer en betekenisvoller te beheren. Met onze Workforce Management-oplossingen geven we bedrijven de tools om efficiënter te werken, compliant te blijven en het volledige potentieel van hun medewerkers te benutten.

Ons motto? Make time valuable.
Onze ambitie? Uitgroeien tot dé nummer 1
in Workforce Management in Europa.

Workforce Management omvat alles rond werktijd: plannen, registreren en correct verwerken tot in de payroll. Planning is daarin de stap vooraan: de juiste mensen, met de juiste skills, op het juiste moment op de juiste plaats
. Wat gepland is, vloeit door naar tijdsregistratie en payroll, en daarom is planning een kernstuk van ons WFM-aanbod.

Binnen onze gevestigde WFM-oplossing is myProtime Planning
een nieuwe toevoeging die volop groeit. We willen het verder uitbouwen en sterker in de markt zetten. Daarvoor zoeken we iemand die zich wil vastbijten in de complexiteit van planning
in Europa en ons helpt de juiste keuzes te maken. Zo bouw je mee aan het succes van myProtime Planning bij klanten. Daar kom jij in beeld!

Wat doe je als Business Analyst Planning?

Jouw missie:
Protime helpen om sterke, onderbouwde productbeslissingen te nemen voor myProtime Planning, door duidelijkheid, context en bewijs te brengen.

Je beweegt je vooral in de problem space: hoe plannen organisaties vandaag, waar lopen ze vast, en wat vraagt de wetgeving in de verschillende Europese landen? Je brengt daar structuur in en zorgt dat we de juiste problemen aanpakken, nog vóór we oplossingen bouwen.

Dat doe je nooit alleen. Je werkt elke dag samen met Product Management, Portfolio Managers, Product Owners, UX en engineering. Daarnaast zoek je actief het gesprek met klanten, sales, support en legal. Je maakt deel uit van het Planning-team en rapporteert aan de Product Manager Planning.

Jouw verantwoordelijkheden

Strategic Discovery

Je verkent hoe organisaties in Europa plannen en wat ze nodig hebben. Denk aan retail, waar de bezetting de drukte volgt, of aan productie en logistiek, waar bedrijven 24/7 draaien met vaste ploegenroosters.
Je verdiept je in de arbeidsregels die een planning raken, zoals rusttijden, maximale arbeidsduur, toeslagen en sectorafspraken, en in GDPR en data-ethiek.
Je combineert desk research met interviews, en haalt eruit wat schaalbaar is over landen heen en wat echt landgebonden is.

Problem Framing

Je zet verspreide signalen van klanten, sales, consultants en support om in duidelijke, testbare probleemstellingen voor planning.
Je herkent welk planningsprobleem een klant echt heeft. Een flexibele bezetting en ploegenwerk zijn verschillende problemen, met elk hun eigen aanpak.
Je definieert context, scope, gebruikers, aannames, risico's en succescriteria.
Je zoekt patronen over klanten, sectoren en landen heen, zodat we niet voor één klant of één land bouwen.

Synthesis & Evidence-Based Decision Support

Je scheidt feiten van hypotheses, en ruis van echte inzichten.
Je bouwt en onderhoudt de opportunity backlog van myProtime Planning, decision logs en de rationale achter keuzes.
Je helpt lichte experimenten en validaties op te zetten.
Met je analyses ondersteun je de keuzes van Product Management en Portfolio Management over markten, prioriteiten en de roadmap van myProtime Planning, en help je het product in de markt te zetten. Samen met hen en met sales maak je duidelijk voor welke klanten en welke planningsproblemen onze oplossing het verschil maakt.

Collaboration & Shaping

Je faciliteert discoveryworkshops, zoals journey mapping, story mapping, event storming en opportunity mapping.
Je werkt samen met Product Owners, architecten en engineers aan coherente MVP's. Ook als de Product Owner de lead neemt in het solution design, blijf je mee aan tafel.
Omdat planning en tijdsregistratie samenhangen, werk je nauw samen met de teams van Time & Attendance, zodat roosters, afwezigheden en contracten op elkaar aansluiten.
Onze andere producten, Strobbo en Checks, raken eveneens aan het planningsdomein. Je werkt er niet zelf aan, maar je deelt actief kennis over planning over de producten heen, zodat we van elkaar leren.

Jij en AI

We bouwen bij Protime aan een agentic manier van werken, waarin AI mee onderzoek doet, informatie samenbrengt en context opbouwt. Je hoeft geen AI-expert te zijn, maar ervaring is een mooie meerwaarde. Wat we wel vragen: je gelooft dat AI een versneller kan zijn om onderzoek te doen, en om de context te creëren waarmee straks iedereen in het team betere beslissingen neemt. En je hebt zin om dat mee vorm te geven.

Jouw skills en mindset om te starten bij Protime

We zoeken iemand die floreert in complexiteit en plezier haalt uit structuur brengen. Een strategisch denker met sterke analytische vaardigheden en uitstekende communicatie.

Ervaring

Minimaal 4 jaar ervaring in Business Analysis, Product Discovery of Service Design. Ervaring met planning, WFM, HR Tech, payroll of andere gereguleerde omgevingen is een plus.
Aantoonbare ervaring in het kaderen van complexe problemen en het vormgeven van MVP's met meetbare resultaten.
Vertrouwd met discoverytechnieken en productmethodologieën.

Mindset

Je voelt je comfortabel in ambiguïteit en in diverse regelgevende contexten.
Je bent een systeemdenker die eerst het probleem kadert in plaats van meteen naar oplossingen te springen.
Je bent een echte teamspeler: je beïnvloedt zonder formele autoriteit en communiceert helder met diverse stakeholders. Engels op C1/C2-niveau is vereist, Nederlands is een pluspunt.
Je bent gemotiveerd om planning en Workforce Management in Europa te begrijpen (of te leren).

Wat bieden wij jou?

Brutoloon:
€3.600 tot €4.800 per maand, afhankelijk van ervaring.

Voordelenpakket:

Bedrijfswagen met tankkaart/laadpas of mobiliteitsbudget
Netto onkostenvergoeding
Maaltijd- en ecocheques
Hospitalisatie- en groepsverzekering
Eindejaarsbonus & jaarlijkse performancebonus
GSM-abonnement & device voucher
Flex Income Plan (cafeteriaplan)
40-urenweek met 20 wettelijke vakantiedagen + 12 ADV-dagen

Waarom kiezen voor Protime?

Bij Protime krijg je de ruimte om te groeien, te experimenteren en écht impact te maken. Samenwerking en collegialiteit zijn voor ons essentieel. Je krijgt vertrouwen en autonomie, maar staat nooit alleen.

Hybride werken en flexibele uren: van thuis en vanuit ons hoofdkantoor in Mechelen
Dynamische omgeving met snelle beslissingslijnen waar nieuwe ideeën welkom zijn
Cultuur van continu leren, coaching & professionele groei

Bij ons heb je nooit "gewoon een dag op kantoor". Elke dag brengt nieuwe inzichten, uitdagingen en kansen om mee de toekomst van Workforce Management in Europa vorm te geven.

Cyber Threat Intelligence SMEs to contribute to a leading-edge customer project focused on evaluating and mapping advanced cyber threat scenarios. No prior experience in AI is required — your domain knowledge is what matters.

Scope of Work

1. Map cyber threat intelligence (CTI) cases to established taxonomies, especially within the surveillance and privacy evaluation domains.
2. Author boundary cases illustrating prohibited surveillance, attribution, and intrusion-adjacent requests, helping delineate permissible and impermissible actions.
3. Evaluate and grade submitted threat responses with special attention to source reliability, analytic reasoning, stated limitations, and actionable utility.
4. Identify and flag instances of over-refusal, ensuring legitimate threat analysis is not unnecessarily declined.
5. Document and clarify challenging edge cases involving nation-state operations and other advanced threats.
6. Provide concise written and verbal feedback to support the continuous improvement of AI threat assessment capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

1. Substantial experience in cyber threat intelligence, particularly where nation-state operations intersect with advanced cyber threats.
2. Expertise in distinguishing between legitimate defensive/analytic activities and impermissible offensive or surveillance-focused requests.
3. Background in threat-actor attribution, APT tracking, or exposure to adversary tactics and techniques.
4. Demonstrated proficiency in authoring clear, structured written content in English and communicating complex concepts verbally.
5. Experience mentoring, teaching, or leading professionals in threat intelligence disciplines.
6. Prior participation in AI system evaluation, red-teaming, or related quality assurance projects is a plus.

What You’ll Do

We’re ALTEN Technology USA, an engineering company helping clients bring groundbreaking ideas to life—from advancing space exploration and life-saving medical devices to building autonomous electric vehicles. With 3,000+ experts across North America, we partner with leading companies in aerospace, medical devices, robotics, automotive, commercial vehicles, EVs, rail, and more.
As part of the global ALTEN Group—57,000+ engineers in 30 countries—we deliver across the entire product development cycle, from consulting to full project outsourcing.
When you join ALTEN Technology USA, you’ll collaborate on some of the world’s toughest engineering challenges, supported by mentorship, career growth opportunities, and comprehensive benefits. We take pride in fostering a culture where employees feel valued, supported, and inspired to grow.
Location: On-site at client, Irvine or Palo Alto, CA
As Technical Program Manager – RMA & Field Failure Analysis you will  lead a hybrid team (on-site in California and offshore in India) performing RMA triage and field failure analysis on automotive ECUs, including Zonal, Infotainment, Telematics and Battery ECUs. You are the client’s main technical and program contact, and you make sure every returned unit moves from triage to root cause and corrective action, on time.

Responsibilities
Technical leadership
Triage incoming RMAs and route each one: on-site analysis, offshore analysis, plant, supplier or external lab
Drive root cause investigations on ECU hardware and firmware, alongside the engineers
Review FTA, RCA and CAPA reports for technical quality before delivery to the client
Support hands-on debug on the bench when needed: failure reproduction, measurements, log extraction
Identify systemic issues and failure trends across vehicle programs

Program management
Manage the RMA backlog and priorities with client engineering
Coordinate daily work between the on-site and offshore teams (PST overlap)
Track KPIs (throughput, turnaround time, backlog) and run the weekly scorecard and monthly reporting
Manage risks, escalations and stakeholders, from engineering and quality teams to suppliers
Structure and improve the RMA process: templates, known-issues database, automation

Requirements
8+ years in automotive electronics, including 3+ years leading technical teams or programs
Strong hands-on background in ECU hardware debug and failure analysis: schematics, PCBA, component-level troubleshooting
Solid understanding of embedded firmware and diagnostics: logs, DTCs, UDS
Knowledge of vehicle networks: CAN/CAN-FD, LIN, Automotive Ethernet
Proven experience with 8D, FTA, 5-Why, RCA and CAPA
Comfortable with lab equipment: oscilloscopes, power supplies, multimeters, CAN tools
Experience coordinating offshore teams
Jira or equivalent ticket tracking; strong reporting skills (Excel / Power BI)
Excellent English communication, both with engineers and with management

Nice to have
RMA or warranty analysis experience at an OEM or Tier 1, ideally in EV
Knowledge of battery management systems, infotainment or telematics ECUs
IPC-A-610, X-ray / CSAM interpretation, experience working with external FA labs
Python scripting for log analysis
PMP or equivalent certification

jobs.title: Safety and Security Manager
jobs.description:
Location:
TDA AGH — Station-Based

Employment Type:
Full-Time

Schedule:
Standard business hours with flexibility to support station operations, safety events, and incident response as needed.

General Purpose Of The Job

Safety is not a department at TDA AGH — it is a culture. As Safety and Security Manager, you play a hands-on role in supporting and sustaining that culture at the station level. Working closely with station management and the TDA Safety team, you will help monitor safety compliance, support incident reporting and investigations, coordinate safety training, and serve as a visible, approachable safety resource for frontline teams. You will be responsible for a region of stations and travel as needed to support multiple operations.

This role is ideal for someone who is detail-oriented, proactive, and genuinely passionate about keeping people safe. You do not need to have all the answers — but you do need to ask the right questions, follow through on every action item, and consistently model the safety-first behaviors TDA expects of everyone on the team.

Essential Duties And Responsibilities

Safety Compliance & Monitoring:

Support the Safety Management System (SMS) program by ensuring safety program elements are being carried out day-to-day.
Monitor station compliance with FAA, TSA, OSHA, IATA, and company safety standards; flag concerns to station management and the Safety team promptly.
Conduct routine safety walkthroughs, inspections, and risk assessments; identify hazards, document findings, and follow up on corrective actions.
Track and report safety and security trends at stations; escalate patterns or recurring issues to leadership.

Incident Reporting & Investigation Support

Assist station management in documenting and reporting safety incidents and accidents accurately and in a timely manner.
Enter and maintain incident records in the SMS management platform.
Support root cause analysis and help track corrective action items through closure.

Training & Safety Education

Coordinate and facilitate monthly station safety meetings and safety workshops.
Distribute and review safety educational materials; ensure all team members have access to current safety resources.
Support the delivery of required safety training through the Learning Management System (LMS); track completion and flag overdue items.
Serve as a visible safety presence — engage with frontline employees, answer safety questions, and reinforce safe behaviors in real time.

Administrative & Program Support

Ensure reporting and documentation requirements are complete and accurate for your stations.
Leverage data and Safety Performance Indicators (SPIs) to drive actions.
Complete all required training.
Report any safety hazard or incident immediately per TDA SMS protocols.
Other duties as assigned by station leadership or the Director of Safety and Security.

Required

REQUIREMENTS AND QUALIFICATIONS:

Experience in the aviation industry or a similarly regulated operational environment.
Basic understanding of FAA, TSA, and OSHA safety regulations as they apply to airport ground handling operations.
Experience with IATA ground handling requirements and ISAGO certification standards.
Strong attention to detail with the ability to document incidents, track action items, and maintain accurate records.
Proficiency in Microsoft Office suite including Word, Excel, and PowerPoint.
Comfortable facilitating group safety meetings and communicating safety information clearly to frontline employees.
Must be able to work on the ramp and in operational areas as part of safety inspections and walkthroughs.
Must be willing to travel 30%.
Must successfully complete a 10-year background check and pre-employment drug screening.
Must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Preferred

Prior experience supporting a Safety Management System (SMS) program.
Experience with the ISAGO standards and certification requirements.
Experience using a Learning Management System (LMS) for training coordination.
OSHA 10-hour General Industry certification or willingness to obtain.
Prior ramp, ground handling, or airline operations experience strongly valued.

Work Environment

This is a station-based role that combines office work with regular time on the ramp and in operational areas. Exposure to outdoor environments including extreme weather conditions, aircraft noise, fuel vapors, jet exhaust, and ground service equipment is expected. Personal protective equipment is required and provided when working in operational areas.

Physical Requirements

Must be able to navigate airport ramp and operational environments safely, including walking on uneven surfaces and working around active aircraft and ground equipment.
Prolonged periods of sitting and computer-based work when in an office or administrative setting.
Must be able to lift up to 25 lbs. occasionally.
Must have sufficient vision and physical ability to safely conduct site inspections and perform all essential functions of the position.

Key Competencies

Safety Mindset: Genuinely committed to keeping people safe; takes safety seriously every day, not just during audits or incidents.
Attention to Detail: Thorough and precise in documentation, inspections, and follow-up; nothing falls through the cracks.
Communication: Clearly conveys safety information to frontline employees and management; approachable, credible, and consistent.
Follow-Through: Tracks every action item, corrective measure, and training requirement to verified completion.
Proactive Awareness: Looks for hazards and trends before incidents occur; raises concerns early and constructively.
Collaboration: Works effectively with station managers, frontline teams, and the TDA Safety department; earns trust as a resource, not just a compliance checker.
Reliability & Accountability: Dependable and self-directed; takes ownership of the safety program at the station level with minimal supervision.
Adaptability: Adjusts priorities fluidly in response to operational changes, incidents, or evolving safety requirements.

jobs.description:
Somos Decolar, parte do ecossistema Prosus, e há mais de 25 anos revolucionamos a forma de viajar na América Latina ✈️. Construímos tecnologia que transforma experiências e conecta milhões de pessoas aos seus sonhos de viagem.

Buscamos talentos que pensem em 10x, ajam com autonomia e gerem impacto real. Se você é apaixonado por inovar, aprender rápido e construir em equipe, este lugar é para você.

Buscamos um(a) Partner Operations Analyst com perfil analítico e resolutivo para assumir as demandas operativas de hotéis e pousadas, conduzindo cada caso até a solução.

A Oportunidade

Como Partner Operations Analyst, você trabalha junto aos Market Managers para garantir uma operação confiável e uma boa experiência para os hotéis e pousadas parceiros da Decolar.

Você assume as demandas operativas da conta~ configuração da extranet, carga de tarifas e promoções, pagamentos, reservas e cancelamentos. Faz o diagnóstico inicial, avalia o impacto, resolve o que está na sua alçada e escala os demais casos, acompanhando até a solução.

Seu trabalho garante que os acordos comerciais sejam executados corretamente, os problemas avancem com prioridade e o parceiro saiba o que está acontecendo. Você mantém a responsabilidade pelo acompanhamento, mesmo quando a resolução depende de outra área, liberando tempo dos Market Managers para relacionamento, negociação e crescimento da carteira.

Como Você Gera Impacto

Primeiro contato e diagnóstico. Recebe demandas dos parceiros e dos Market Managers, reúne informações e identifica o problema, sua urgência e seu impacto na operação e na venda.

Priorização e resolução. Resolve os casos dentro do seu escopo e escala os demais com diagnóstico e evidências, garantindo encaminhamento correto e acompanhamento até a solução.

Configuração da conta. Apoia a manutenção de cadastros, conteúdo, acomodações, políticas e acessos na extranet, identificando e corrigindo inconsistências.

Execução dos acordos comerciais. Realiza a carga e manutenção de tarifas, disponibilidade e promoções conforme as condições acordadas pelo parceiro e pelo Market Manager, validando a configuração.

Demandas de reservas e pagamentos. Investiga problemas com reservas, cancelamentos, cobranças e repasses, trabalhando com as áreas responsáveis para destravar a resolução.

Comunicação proativa. Mantém o parceiro informado sobre o andamento, os próximos passos e os prazos. Traduz temas técnicos e financeiros em explicações claras, com empatia e foco na solução.

Disciplina de acompanhamento. Documenta, acompanha e monitora os casos no HubSpot e nas ferramentas de tickets, mantendo histórico, responsáveis e compromissos atualizados.

Parceria com Market Management. Acompanha a saúde operativa das contas e os compromissos com os parceiros. Contribui com diagnósticos e informações para revisões de serviço e business reviews.

Colaboração entre áreas. Trabalha com Financeiro, Reservas, Atendimento, Conectividade e Tecnologia para resolver casos complexos e garantir continuidade no atendimento.

Melhoria contínua. Identifica problemas recorrentes e propõe melhorias em processos, rotinas e guias de resolução, reduzindo retrabalho e aumentando a autonomia dos parceiros.

O Que Te Diferencia?

2 a 4 anos de experiência em Customer Operations, Customer Success, suporte B2B ou operações de parceiros.

Experiência em diagnóstico e resolução de problemas operativos ou técnicos, em colaboração com equipes de atendimento e gestão de contas.

Comunicação clara, escuta ativa e empatia para lidar com parceiros, inclusive em situações de pressão.

Senso de dono~ assume o acompanhamento do caso e garante retorno e conclusão.

Familiaridade com processos de gestão de incidentes, problemas e mudanças.

Conhecimento de hotelaria, OTAs, extranet, tarifas, promoções, reservas e pagamentos é diferencial.

Familiaridade com ferramentas de monitoramento e uso de dados para acompanhar a operação.

Autonomia real para tomar decisões e impactar desde o dia 1

Cultura de aprendizado contínuo~ falhamos rápido, aprendemos e escalamos

Time diverso, colaborativo e sem silos

Valorizamos o ownership, a inovação e colocar as pessoas no centro.

jobs.description:
Job Summary:

The Erlanger Health Foundation, the philanthropic arm of Erlanger Health System, engages donors, cultivates strategic partnerships, and advances institutional priorities through comprehensive fundraising initiatives. As the Foundation continues its evolution into a high-performing, data-informed, donor-centered organization, the Development Operations Analyst serves as a key operational leader responsible for the strategic administration and optimization of development systems, analytics, project management, and operational processes.

Reporting to the Marketing, Communications and Foundation Operations Manager, this position exercises independent judgment and discretion in the oversight, administration, and continuous improvement of the Foundation’s donor database systems, reporting and analytics infrastructure, stewardship operations, project initiatives, and compliance protocols. The Development Operations Analyst ensures alignment between operational practices and organizational objectives, regulatory standards, and donor intent. The Analyst coordinates cross-functional projects that support fundraising operations, data integrity, system enhancements, reporting initiatives, and process improvements.

This role requires consistent exercise of discretion and independent judgment with respect to matters of significance, including donor data governance, gift processing protocols, reporting standards, stewardship implementation, system optimization, and development-related project management.

The position evaluates and refines operational policies, develops procedures to enhance efficiency and compliance, and serves as a subject matter expert on development systems, analytics, and operational project management. The Analyst provides consultative guidance to development staff and leadership regarding donor data interpretation, reporting strategy, gift documentation standards, project priorities, performance metrics, system enhancements, process improvement, and regulatory considerations. The Analyst also uses development analytics and project performance data to evaluate outcomes, identify trends and opportunities, inform resource allocation, and support continuous improvement of the Foundation’s fundraising operations.

jobs.description:
About the role:

The Data Analyst II independently delivers reporting, analytics, and data solutions that help business partners make informed decisions. The role combines technical execution with business partnership and is expected to translate requirements into accurate, scalable, and maintainable solutions while contributing to the modernization of the company’s analytical environment. 
Data Analyst IIs work broadly across business and technology teams, develop reusable reporting and semantic-model capabilities, improve self-service access to trusted data, and identify opportunities to consolidate reporting, automate recurring work, and strengthen data governance. 
What’s in it for you:

Competitive compensation and performance-based rewards 
Opportunity to work with industry-leading data and analytics tools 
Collaborative team environment with strong mentorship and career growth opportunities
Hybrid work environment with the ability to work remotely 40 hours per month

What you’ll be doing:

Analytics & Reporting Delivery

Independently gather requirements, analyze business needs, and deliver accurate reporting, dashboards, analyses, and data solutions using appropriate analytical methods. 
Develop and maintain Power BI, Tableau, or comparable business intelligence solutions that clearly communicate business performance and actionable insights. 
Write, optimize, and validate SQL used to source, transform, reconcile, and analyze data across relational data platforms. 
Own assigned work from requirements through testing, documentation, implementation, support, and ongoing enhancement. 

Reporting Modernization & Semantic Models

Identify opportunities to consolidate duplicative or fragmented reporting into sustainable, reusable solutions that serve broader business needs. 
Build and maintain well-structured dimensional models and shared semantic models with consistent measures, relationships, and business definitions. 
Develop reusable data foundations that improve self-service reporting and can support automation, AI, or agent-based analytical experiences. 
Balance immediate reporting needs with maintainability, scalability, reuse, and long-term reduction of manual analytical work. 

Data Quality, Governance & Operational Improvement

Validate data accuracy and investigate discrepancies across source systems, transformations, semantic models, and reports. 
Follow and contribute to standards for data modeling, metric definitions, documentation, security, row-level access, testing, and solution support. 
Identify recurring requests and manual processes that can be standardized, automated, or redesigned to improve efficiency and reduce ad-hoc demand. 

Business Partnership & Collaboration

Build effective relationships with business partners and translate ambiguous questions into clear analytical requirements and solutions. 
Communicate findings, assumptions, limitations, risks, and recommendations clearly to technical and non-technical audiences. 
Respectfully challenge requests when a more scalable or sustainable approach is available. 
Collaborate with Data Engineering, Data Science, Platform Engineering, Product, Software Development, Sales, Sales Support, and other business teams. 

What you need:

Bachelor’s degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Analytics, Data Science, Engineering, Computer Science, Information Systems, Business, Economics, or a related field, or equivalent education and relevant experience. 
2+ years of experience in data analytics, business intelligence, reporting, or a related discipline preferred; candidates with less experience may be considered when technical capability and relevant experience are strong. 
Experience using SQL Server Management Studio (SSMS) or another relational database management system such as MySQL, Oracle, or PostgreSQL. 
Experience building business intelligence solutions using Power BI, Tableau, or a comparable visualization platform. 
Experience with dimensional data modeling, including star or snowflake schemas, and the development or use of shared semantic models. 
Experience using Microsoft Fabric or a comparable modern analytics platform. 
Experience with data validation, requirements gathering, documentation, and supporting production analytical solutions. 
Experience with Python, RStudio, Databricks, Informatica, Microsoft Azure, AWS, or comparable data and cloud technologies. 
Experience with database concepts including normalization, entity relationship diagrams, security, and row-level security. 
Experience supporting reporting consolidation, self-service analytics, automation, AI-enabled analytics, or data-governance initiatives.

jobs.description:
About Figure

Figure (NASDAQ: FIGR) is transforming capital markets through blockchain. We’re proving that blockchain isn’t just theory - it’s powering real products used by hundreds of thousands of consumers and institutions.

By combining blockchain’s transparency and efficiency with AI-driven automation, we’ve reimagined how loans are originated, funded, and traded in secondary markets. From faster processing times to lower costs and reduced bias, our technology is helping borrowers, investors, and financial institutions achieve better outcomes.

Together with our 170+ partners, we’ve originated over $22 billion in home equity loans (HELOCs) on our blockchain-native platform, making Figure the largest non-bank provider of home equity financing in the U.S. Figure’s ecosystem also includes YLDS, an SEC-registered yield-bearing stablecoin that operates as a tokenized money market fund, and several other products and platforms that are reshaping consumer finance and capital markets.

We’re proud to be recognized as one of Forbes’ Most Innovative Fintech Startups in 2025 and Fast Company’s Most Innovative Companies in Finance and Personal Finance.

About The Role

At Figure, we’re redefining what’s possible at the intersection of finance and technology. Fresh off our IPO, we are building the next generation of financial infrastructure, transforming how capital moves, how credit is assessed, and how customers experience financial products. Our data team sits at the heart of that transformation, serving as the analytical engine that powers the entire business. From architecting the data models that drive risk and capital allocation to delivering the reporting and insights that guide growth strategy and operational excellence, we ensure every department has the intelligence needed to win.

As a Senior Data Analyst, you will be a vital driver of our growth and product evolution, partnering closely with Marketing, Product Management, and Engineering to optimize the borrower journey. Your work will directly influence how we acquire customers, the efficiency of our loan application funnel, and the long-term value of our customer base.

You will bridge the gap between user behavior and business strategy, combining analytical rigor with product intuition to help leaders understand the "how" and "why" behind the customer experience. While your primary focus is on the front-end growth engine, you are a generalist at heart—capable of architecting data models that serve the entire organization’s need for clear, actionable intelligence from top-of-funnel to capital allocation.

What You’ll Do

Data Modeling & Architecture: Design and implement robust data models that transform fragmented marketing spend and application event logs into structured, "gold-standard" datasets. You will ensure our product and acquisition data is clean, organized, and optimized for cross-functional use.
Funnel Optimization: Build and maintain scalable frameworks to monitor the loan application funnel—identifying friction points, drop-off behaviors, and opportunities to improve conversion from lead to funded loan.
Technical Impact: Elevate our analytics toolkit by writing high-performance BigQuery SQL and designing intuitive Tableau dashboards that empower stakeholders to track KPIs like CAC (Customer Acquisition Cost), Approval Rates, and Origination Volume in real-time.
Experimental Design: Partner with Product and Marketing to design, execute, and analyze A/B tests, ensuring we make evidence-based decisions on everything from landing page optimization to credit offer presentation.
Cross-Functional Insight: Act as the analytical backbone for the business, translating complex user behaviors into repeatable, automated insights that drive measurable growth and product-market fit.

What We Look For

3–5+ years of experience using data to drive measurable business impact, specifically within Growth, Product Analytics, or Marketing Science.
Deep proficiency in SQL (preferably BigQuery); you are an expert at handling complex joins and window functions to reconstruct user journeys across marketing touchpoints and loan applications.
Advanced Data Modeling: Proven ability to design and maintain structured datasets (star schemas, dbt models) that turn messy clickstream and CRM data into reliable tables for the entire business.
Expertise with Tableau: You don’t just report data; you build intuitive dashboards that help managers visualize cohort performance, attribution models, and funnel velocity.
Statistical Depth: Strong grasp of statistical concepts like survival analysis (to model time-to-repayment or time-to-next-loan), causal inference, and significance testing.
Fintech/Lending Context: Understanding of the lending lifecycle—from initial acquisition through underwriting to funding—and how product changes impact portfolio quality.
Communication: Clear, confident ability to translate complex data trends into actionable stories for both technical teams and executive leadership.
Adaptability: A generalist mindset—you are comfortable navigating the ambiguity of a fast-moving environment and can apply your analytical toolkit to solve problems across different business domains.
Adhere to all company security policies and data handling procedures.
Complete mandatory security awareness training within required timeframes.
Promptly report any suspected security incidents or suspicious activity to the Security team.

Salary

Base Compensation Range: $110,000 - $140,000 annually
25% annual bonus target, paid quarterly
Company equity in the form of RSUs

This is the compensation range for the role in the United States. Actual compensation may vary based on a candidate’s experience, skills, location, internal equity, and evolving business needs. While most offers are generally made within the middle of the range, final compensation is determined based on the factors above.

Comprehensive medical, dental, and vision coverage, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employees and their dependents on select plans Company HSA, FSA, Dependent Care FSA, 401(k), and commuter benefits Employer-paid life and disability insurance 11 observed holidays and PTO plan Up to 12 weeks of paid family leave Continuing education reimbursement

About The Team

Turo is looking for a Senior Data Analyst to join our Analytics team in San Francisco, partnering directly with the Global Owned Media team. In this role, you’ll turn customer data into practical measurement frameworks that help us market smarter and more efficiently. You will bring strong analytical rigor and commercial judgment to deepen customer engagement, evaluate promotional spend, and guide how we invest across our marketing portfolio.

What You Will Do

Lead High-Impact Analysis: Take on our most important business questions and drive them from initial hypothesis to concrete recommendation. You’ll dig into complex data, isolate what matters, and deliver clear takeaways that guide business decisions.
Drive Experimentation: Partner with marketing teams to design, run, and analyze A/B tests and holdout groups. You’ll measure true incremental lift, uncover how customers respond to promos and incentives, and help shape a testing roadmap focused on the highest-upside opportunities.
Build Smarter Segmentation: Turn behavioral and transactional data into clear audience segments. You’ll guide personalized targeting and ensure messages reach users at the moments that drive the highest engagement and return.
Shape Customer Data Infrastructure: Partner with MarTech, Engineering, and Product teams to define CDP tracking requirements, new user attributes, and data pipelines. You will help design the underlying data structures needed to power advanced lifecycle and personalization initiatives.
Measure Retention & Lifetime Value: Analyze repeat behavior, churn, and long-term customer value. Your findings will guide budget allocation across segments and channels to drive sustainable growth.
Communicate Insights & Align Teams: Translate technical analysis into straightforward recommendations for leadership. You’ll partner across Marketing, Business, Product, and Finance so everyone is aligned on how we measure marketing impact.

Your profile

4+ years in marketing, growth, or product analytics, ideally in tech or a two-sided marketplace.
Experimentation track record: Hands-on experience designing, running, and analyzing A/B tests and incrementality lift studies.
Lifecycle & customer analytics: Practical experience analyzing direct customer touchpoints (email, push, in-app), with a track record of measuring which incentives genuinely drive repeat behavior.
Advanced measurement: Experience interpreting and applying outputs from measurement models (such as MMM, attribution frameworks, and lift tests) to guide strategic decisions.
Commercial impact: Proven ability to evaluate customer economics (retention curves, repeat rate, LTV, promotional ROI) and translate those metrics into business action.
Technical toolkit: Advanced SQL and experience building clear, functional dashboards in BI tools like Tableau, Domo, or Power BI. Python or R for data analysis is a strong plus.
Analytical judgment: You do not just pull data. You connect your findings directly to business decisions and marketing strategy.
Ownership: You take end-to-end accountability for your projects, move work forward without needing a strict checklist, and follow through until the business takes action.
Communication: Ability to clearly explain complex data, methodologies, and trade-offs to cross-functional partners and leadership.
AI fluency: Hands-on experience using AI tools (such as Claude, Cursor, or Copilot) to accelerate coding, automate analysis, and work more efficiently.

jobs.title: Data Analyst
jobs.description:
About Fabric Health

At Fabric Health, we are powering boundless care by solving healthcare’s biggest challenge: clinical capacity. We aren’t here to disrupt healthcare; we’re here to fix it. We unify the care journey from intake to treatment, using intelligent automation to remove administrative burdens and make care delivery 2-10x more efficient. Our technology empowers clinicians to move faster and focus on what matters most: the patient.

We are a mission-driven team of brilliant minds trusted by leading organizations including Intermountain Health, OSF HealthCare, SSM Health, and MUSC Health. Our vision is backed by premier investors such as Thrive Capital, GV (Google Ventures), General Catalyst, and Salesforce Ventures. We move quickly for good reason, listen deeply to solve big challenges, and build products with the same care and quality we’d want for our own loved ones.

Learn more:
About Us | News & Press | LinkedIn | Careers

About The Role

Fabric is looking to bring on a Data Analyst to provide customer insights and support our medical leadership through actionable reporting. As part of our analytics team, you partner with the clinical organization to deliver strategic analyses and build automated reporting around clinical operations and health outcomes. You will dive into complex datasets to analyze trends, identify opportunities, and quantify the potential value of new initiatives. Your work helps ensure our clients have clear visibility into the clinical value Fabric provides, supporting the continuous improvement of our medical practice to best serve our patients.

This role requires proven quantitative and critical thinking skills along with a solid understanding of healthcare analytics. As a vital contributor to a lean team, you clearly communicate complex findings to diverse audiences, collaborate across multiple functions, and leverage modern AI tools to accelerate data processing and generate insights.

What You'll Do

As a Data Analyst, your primary responsibilities include:

Build and maintaining reporting that tracks physician performance, care quality, and consistency of clinical standards across the platform.
Design dashboards and visualizations that make clinical and business metrics easy to act on for both clinical and non-clinical leaders.
Partner closely with our client-facing organization to surface clinical insights for customers and prospects.
Collaborate with clinical operations and physician enterprise leaders to translate open questions into clear, well-scoped analyses.
Write and maintaining SQL for the data warehouse to transform raw clinical and operational data into analysis-ready datasets, utilizing AI coding assistants to accelerate query development.
Collaborate with product and engineering teams to improve the quality, structure, and reliability of underlying clinical data.
Support ongoing reporting needs to help the team move from one-off requests toward scalable, repeatable reporting.
Leverage AI tools for advanced data cleaning, initial pattern recognition, and drafting analytical summaries to increase efficiency.

Why You Might Be a Good Fit

You enjoy translating ambiguous clinical questions into clear, actionable data models and dashboards.
You have a solid foundation in healthcare analytics and understand the nuances of clinical and operational data.
You excel at bridging the gap between technical data engineering and business-facing clinical leadership.
You are proactive in seeking out ways to scale reporting rather than manually answering the same questions repeatedly.
You are an early adopter of technology, actively using AI tools to write queries faster and streamline your analytical workflows.

This Might Not Be The Right Fit If...

You prefer working with perfectly clean, strictly structured data over navigating the messy reality of real-world healthcare datasets.
You want to focus solely on building complex machine learning models rather than delivering practical, descriptive analytics and BI reporting.
You struggle to communicate technical findings to non-technical stakeholders in a clear, digestible manner.
You prefer traditional manual coding workflows and are hesitant to adopt AI assistants to scale your data analysis tasks.

Your Qualifications

2+ years of experience analyzing data in a professional setting, ideally within healthcare.
Proven proficiency in SQL.
Experience building dashboards or reports in a BI tool such as Tableau or Thoughtspot.
Familiarity with Python or R for complex analyses.
Proficiency in utilizing modern AI assistants for query generation, data cleaning, and workflow automation.
Bachelor’s degree, preferably in a quantitative discipline; an advanced degree is a plus.
Comfort managing multiple analysis projects at once and adapting to shifting priorities in a fast-paced environment.

Bonus Points

Familiarity with common healthcare datasets, standards, and measures such as HEDIS.
Experience with analytics tools such as Heap, Mixpanel, or Amplitude.
Experience with A/B testing, including statistical hypothesis testing methodologies.
Experience working within Databricks.

The national pay range for this role is $90,000.00 – $130,000.00 per year. Actual compensation will be determined by factors such as the candidate's geographic market, experience, skills, and qualifications. Certain roles may also be eligible for additional compensation, including a comprehensive benefits package such as medical, dental, vision, unlimited PTO, and a 401(k) plan, stock options and bonuses. If your compensation requirement is greater than our posted range, please still consider applying; a determination can be made based on unique qualifications. Expected compensation ranges for this role may change over time.

At Fabric, we believe that a diverse workforce is essential to our success. We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristic. We actively encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply.

Recruitment Fraud Alert: Protect Yourself

Fabric Health Is Aware Of Scammers Attempting To Impersonate Employers. To Ensure That Any Recruiting Contact You Receive Is Legitimate, Please Adhere To The Following

Verify the Domain: Official recruitment emails will only come from addresses ending in @fabrichealth.com or @gem.com. No other domain names are legitimate.
Official Interview Tools: We use Gem for our recruitment process and Google Meet for all video interviews. Google Meet is always the platform used for your first interview; you will never be sent a Zoom link to set up or conduct an initial interview. All interviews are conducted via video unless specifically stated by our team as an audio call. We never conduct interviews via chat, social media, Skype, or WhatsApp.
Zoom Usage: Zoom is utilized only for specific meetings set directly by our team for purposes outside of the standard interview process (e.g., coordination or onboarding discussions). It is never the first link you will receive from us.
Authorized Contact & Texting: Fabric will only contact you if you have submitted an application or if you are connected to a current employee who shared your information with us. We will only send text messages if you have provided explicit authorization and consent, either through your application or while communicating directly with our team. If you have not explicitly authorized us to reach out, treat any SMS or unsolicited outreach as fraudulent and do not respond.
Sensitive Data: We will never ask you for sensitive personal or financial documents (ID, banking info, SSN) during the application, interview, or candidacy stages. All sensitive data is handled through secure internal systems post-offer.
Verify the Team: You can reference LinkedIn to verify members of our recruiting team; however, please remain vigilant as scammers may create fraudulent profiles. Always cross-reference the sender's email domain with our official @fabrichealth.com address.

If you question the validity of a contact or receive a suspicious message, do not click any links. Please submit a report via this link: https://forms.gle/N1AGAiXcAL2W57H9A

Please note:
The security inbox is for reporting fraudulent activity only. Do not email this address for application status updates or to share application materials, as these will not be reviewed. Applications are only accepted and reviewed if submitted through our official application portal, and no application status information will be provided via the security email.
